ticket.body: Hello, I am writing to request a cancellation of our Team subscription with Quillon Publishing. We have decided to switch to a different product and would like to ensure our account is closed. Our account was billed $110 for this month's service. Since we have only used it for nine days, would it be possible to receive a refund for this charge? Thank you in advance for your assistance.

labels.label_note: Drafted: Owner, monthly Team charge of $110 made 9 days ago: inside the 30-day window of REF-001.1. $110 is in the USD 50.01-500 band, so ESC-001.2 needs support manager approval. Cancellation is fine under CAN-001.1.
